page_title: BRE 0-0 FUL | Brentford v Fulham 04/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Graham Scott is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.
90+5' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Brentford will take a corner kick.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Harry Wilson (Fulham) comes onto the pitch for Alex Iwobi.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
89' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

88' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat. The ball goes out of play. Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
85' Brentford take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
85' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Brentford get a corner.
82' Thomas Frank has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kevin Schade (Brentford) replacing Mikkel Damsgaard.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Frank Onyeka (Brentford) will replace Christian Norgaard.
80' Tom Cairney (Fulham) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

80' Mark Flekken was forced into action to thwart Adama Traore (Fulham). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper. Now Fulham have a corner.
79' The corner from Tom Cairney (Fulham) is intercepted by the defence.
78' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
78' A lofted cross from Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
75' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Sasa Lukic is replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) is coming onto the pitch as Andreas Pereira cannot continue after picking up an injury.

74' CHANCE! Raul Jimenez (Fulham) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
72' PENALTY APPEAL by Brentford, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
72' The attendance for today's match is 17090.
68' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
67' Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
66' Thomas Frank has decided to make a change. Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) replaces Vitaly Janelt.
66' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Keane Lewis-Potter walks off the pitch to be replaced by Yoane Wissa (Brentford).
65' Here is a change. Rodrigo Muniz is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Raul Jimenez (Fulham).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Willian departs the field of play to be replaced by Adama Traore (Fulham).
63' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.

60' The corner from Andreas Pereira evades the keeper, but Timothy Castagne (Fulham) can't keep his close-range header down and fires it just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
60' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
60' A pass lands at the feet of Andreas Pereira (Fulham) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Fulham win a corner.
59' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
57' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
54' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
53' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
49' A pass from Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is intercepted by Bernd Leno and the move breaks down.

48' A short pass finds Andreas Pereira (Fulham). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
47' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) tries to find Rodrigo Muniz, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+7' Graham Scott blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' A dangerous looking corner kick from Sergio Reguilon (Brentford) is cleared to safety by the defence.
45+4' Substitution. Kristoffer Ajer walks off the pitch and Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) comes on as a substitute.
45+3' It doesn’t look good for Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45' Brentford quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

44' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball is out of play. Brentford will have a chance to score from a corner.
43' Willian (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
41' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is able to continue to play.
40' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
40' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
39' An attempted cross from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is cleared.
39' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

37' The rebound finds Christian Norgaard (Brentford) in space inside the box, but his shot goes well wide of the left post. That was a promising chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
35' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Alex Iwobi (Fulham) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Mark Flekken easily catches the ball.
32' Willian (Fulham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
31' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is behind the touchline and Brentford will take a throw-in.
28' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) launches a cross from the corner, but Mark Flekken is alert to thwart the effort.
24' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.

23' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
22' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.

14' Bernd Leno pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) fired on target from the rebound. His effort from inside the box was directed low to the middle of the goal.
13' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the crossbar. Unlucky!
13' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
12' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
8' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
6' Ivan Toney (Brentford) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.

5' Brentford are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception. The ball has crossed the sideline. Fulham are taking a throw-in.
2' The corner from Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is cleared away by the defence.
2' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

2' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Sasa Lukic (Fulham) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The linesman makes the right call and Fulham will have a corner.
1' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. It's a throw-in for Fulham.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Fulham will kick the game off.
Graham Scott got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
